slides.kicker: One week, one Cabo rental group
slides.head:
120 rental posts.
75 actual listings.
body: I read a week of posts in one of the bigger Los Cabos rental groups on Facebook. Here's what I found.

slides.head:
The same homes,
posted again
body: 120 rental posts came down to 75 different listings once the repeats were merged. One 4-bedroom went up four times in two days.

slides.head: No lease term
body: 38 of those 75 listings didn't say how long the lease was. Only 33 clearly said long-term.

slides.head:
Two prices,
one rent
body: Some posts gave the rent in dollars and in pesos, and the two numbers didn't match.

slides.head:
Long-term rentals only,
in one place
body: Search by area. Filter by price, bedrooms and move-in date. Message the owner or agent, and sign a bilingual lease in the app.
